decision_value_endpoint_contract.confirmation_endpoint_deferred: paired portfolio log-growth after a finalist is frozen
decision_value_endpoint_contract.definition: (NetCash(HOLD one legal step then pi0) - NetCash(EXIT now)) / CurrentNotional
decision_value_endpoint_contract.single_override_direct_gain: (candidate_action - pi0_action) * Y_t * CurrentNotional, with action coding bound explicitly before execution

disposition_reason: A row-level decision-value core appears present, but explicit baseline-action or notional/cashflow semantics are not sufficiently bound by header-level authority for a canonical DirectGain ledger.

economic_mue.reason: 5% reference-MSE is retired as the global definition of economic importance. A policy economic MUE must be frozen before confirmation from portfolio economics, costs, risk budget and feasible intervention rate; this certificate does not select it after observing candidate performance.

failure_mode_decomposition_contract.estimator_test: Given the same DGP and rows, how much power/value is lost by the estimator relative to oracle conditional value?
failure_mode_decomposition_contract.inference_test: Given oracle predictions or exact action values, how much power is lost by the qualification gate/inference procedure?
failure_mode_decomposition_contract.information_test: Can an oracle using the frozen simulated/derived DGP separate null from the predeclared economic alternative?
failure_mode_decomposition_contract.why: Executing a new oracle/policy simulation would exceed this certificate's no-new-replay/no-new-model scope. The certificate binds the decomposition so the next pilot cannot conflate these failure modes.

next_contract.if_authority_gap: Bind/export only the missing derived columns from already-authorized pre-2024 sources; no general raw reopening.

old_inference_diagnosis.interpretation: The limited-repair inference architecture was not validated for the old MSE proxy. These values are retained as diagnosis only and are not transferred as policy-value power.

old_proxy_power_planning.warning: This is a planning diagnostic for the old MSE proxy only; it is not policy-value power and must not be used as an economic qualification gate.

what_is_not_proven: No M1/M2 model has been trained.
No policy-value confidence interval has been computed.
No D2 breadth expansion has been justified or executed.
what_is_proven: Old P0/MSE proxy power cannot be transferred automatically to direct policy-value power.
The new program is bounded to selective one-override policy value and requires its own inference qualification.
